head: 0f2b8d3447d2169313ac45599f6306a9fd3040d6
reasons: The Important finding left open on purpose (verified_with carries only the Claude Code version in 30 of 32 docs/notes/<N>.md files, a plugin version in 2, and a runner value in none, though spec.md Requirements/Design explicitly ask for all three) goes to the core of intent.md's own problem statement: the whole reason this change introduces verified_with/stale_after is to make staleness mechanically checkable instead of a session working it out section by section (intent.md Problem). With the field incomplete for almost every file, the mechanism the change was commissioned to deliver does not actually work as designed for nearly the whole corpus -- this is a gap in the artifact's fitness for its stated purpose, not a cosmetic shortfall.

review-response.md's own research pass states that the plugin version is derivable for every file (via the note's title/heading, correcting for the fact that one generated.at date covers several sittings on different plugin versions) and that only the runner value is genuinely unrecoverable for roughly half the files (sessions 2-14). Despite that, the diff for this round makes zero change to any of the 32 docs/notes/<N>.md frontmatter blocks -- not even the plugin-version component the response itself says is knowable, and not even for the later sessions (15-18, notes 27-32) whose PROGRESS records explicitly name the plugin version and the CI/cloud runner for every run. The round's conclusion ("worse to fabricate than leave incomplete") only addresses the unrecoverable half; it does not explain why the recoverable half was also left untouched, so the finding was not actually closed with a decision proportionate to the round's own evidence -- it was fully deferred.

The sole support for "reconstructing the correct values would require inferring data the historical record does not state" is a sub-agent research pass whose transcript is explicitly not committed ("is in this round's sub-agent transcript and is not re-filed here since it is not committed evidence"). There is no artifact in the diff or evidence/ that lets a reviewer or the owner check which files are genuinely unrecoverable versus which were simply not attempted; this is the author's claim about its own unaudited research, not inspectable proof, and it is the entire basis for leaving an Important, spec-mandated field unresolved across the whole corpus.
classification_reasons: An open concern remains (the verified_with three-part requirement, Important severity) that this round chose not to close with a fix matching its own stated findings, so the spec is not tight for this build.

126 files changed across docs/, HANDOFF.md, README.md, ROADMAP.md, OPERATING_MODEL.md and the change's own evidence tree; while no plugin/template/tests file changed and no risk_list item or schema/contract is touched, the sheer file count and the cross-cutting rewiring of three load-bearing reference docs is not a small blast radius.

No existing automated test covers link/citation resolution or frontmatter completeness for the new docs/notes, docs/decisions or docs/progress trees (plan.md Proof: 'no automated test exists for this today... evidence collected by hand'), so the existing test suite does not already cover the behavior this change adds.
attempted: Intent: compared the shipped docs/notes/<N>.md frontmatter against intent.md's stated reason for verified_with/stale_after (making staleness mechanically checkable); found the field incomplete for 30-32 files, which undercuts that stated purpose for most of the corpus.

Spec and plan: read spec.md Requirements/Design/Acceptance and plan.md's files-that-change and order-of-work; confirmed the docs/PROGRESS.md splice (previously flagged Important) is now fixed -- the file has two separate top-level headings ('# Change 0001 ...' and '# Progress -- session 18, third sitting ...') rather than one spliced into the other; independently grepped verified_with across all 32 docs/notes files to confirm review-findings.json's and verifier.md's counts (30 only Claude Code version, 2 add a plugin version, 0 add a runner) and found the later-session files (27-32) that the response's own research says should be more determinable were not touched either.

Proof: evidence/test.log, build.log, lint.log carry the 'deferred to the runner' header as expected for a CI session (not a gap); verifier.md's phase c/d read matches the frontmatter gap found independently. The one piece of proof actually offered for leaving the Important finding open -- a cross-referencing research pass -- is not committed anywhere (review-response.md says so explicitly), so that specific claim could not be checked and is flagged above.

Blast radius: confirmed via the diff --stat that no file under plugin/, template/ or tests/ changed (no guardrail, no risk_list item, no schema/contract); the change is documentation-only as intended, but touches 126 files across every major reference doc.

Policies: security-baseline/data-conventions do not apply (no secret or personal data moved); ux-conventions does not apply; REVIEW.md's framework rules (guardrail files untouched, plan.md matches the diff's file list) hold.

Tests: no test exists for the behavior this change adds (frontmatter completeness, link resolution), so a weakened pre-existing test is not a concern here, but it also means nothing in CI would catch the verified_with gap going forward.
